slots.name: items
slots.about: the saved ranking: id (1 up), name, pos (1 to the count, each once); 2 or more

slots.name: status_line
slots.about: the line between Cancel and Save; may read changed

slots.name: picked_line
slots.about: the foot line while a row is picked; may read picked_name, picked_pos and count

slots.name: hint_line
slots.about: the foot line while nothing is picked

slots.name: pick
slots.about: {event, value expression, label}: picks the row (value: it.id), or puts it down if it is already picked

slots.name: up
slots.about: {event, value expression, label}: moves the picked row one place up

slots.name: down
slots.about: {event, value expression, label}: moves the picked row one place down

slots.name: to_top
slots.about: {event, value expression, label}: moves the picked row to first place

slots.name: save
slots.about: {event, value expression, label}: keeps the new order, when it differs from the saved one

slots.name: cancel
slots.about: {event, value expression, label}: drops the changes and goes back to the saved order

empty.shows: the ranking with a hint to tap a row; no move buttons

attention.shows: Cancel and Save brighten and the status says the order changed

fallback.shows: Cancel and Save dimmed; Save does nothing

accessibility.reduce_motion: the phone drops smooth, swap, rise and shrink
accessibility.not_colour_alone: the picked row gets a check and the foot line names it and its place, and the status line says when the order changed
